description: In-silico protease/chemical digestion: cleave a protein and report each peptide's position, length and neutral mass. CNBr masses assume terminal Met becomes homoserine lactone; the sequence retains M and the response labels the modification.

maxMass.description: Optional upper bound on neutral monoisotopic mass (Da).

maxPeptides.description: Cap on the number of returned peptides.

minMass.description: Optional lower bound on neutral monoisotopic mass (Da).

sequence.description: Protein sequence (one-letter amino-acid codes; non-AA characters ignored).

name: protease_digestion
title: Protease Digestion
